cells.announcement: June 23, 2026: End-of-Life (EoL) announcement  – Customers on NTM 2.3 should begin transitioning to the latest version NTM.
cells.eoe: July 23, 2026: End-of-Engineering (EoE)  – Service releases, bug fixes, workarounds, and service packs for NTM 2.3 will no longer be supported by SolarWinds.
cells.eol: July 23, 2027: End-of-Life  –SolarWinds will no longer provide technical support for NTM 2.3.
